See you soon, have a nice one!"; on 2023-09-13, reconnected with Calvin (who apologized for the slow reply): congratulated Calvin on his album release (it dropped 2023-09-11 — "that's awesome!") and asked if it was overwhelming or inspiring; affirmed it's a great feeling when your work gets noticed and makes a positive difference ("motivating ... keep chasing your dreams"); marveled that Calvin has "come a long way since we started talking music" and asked what's next; when Calvin announced an upcoming tour followed by exploring and growing his brand, Dave congratulated him ("Can't wait to see you perform!") and asked what cities or venues are in mind (unanswered); the chat ended with Dave saying live music is the best and offering to show Calvin around his garage and its cool cars (shared a photo of a car in a garage with a Coca-Cola sign — "looks stunning!"), Calvin accepting the offer and re-pledging to let Dave know when he's in Boston, and the two exchanging warm goodbyes; on 2023-09-02, reconnected with Calvin ("Hey Calvin! Been a while, what's up?"): said he's been "tied up with car stuff lately" and came back from San Francisco the day before (2023-09-01) with "some great insights and knowledge on car modification" — "Changing things around, and giving an old car a new life - so satisfying!" — and that fixing stuff up is "really rewarding and gives me a sense of purpose", that fixing someone's car feels like making a difference, and that seeing their relief "makes me proud!"; Calvin said he must feel like "their superhero" and should be proud, then announced he booked a flight to Boston last week (~2023-08-26 through 09-01) and is so excited about the upcoming trip (photo of a book with a boarding pass); Dave: "Cool! Let me know when you're free and we can catch up in Boston." and Calvin: "I'll let you know when I'm in Boston. See you soon!", and the chat closed with Dave looking forward to seeing Calvin ("Have a safe trip, see ya!") and Calvin promising to contact him when he arrives; on 2023-08-31, reconnected with Calvin ("Long time no chat!"): asked how the end of Calvin's tour was, marveled at Calvin's concert-crowd photo ("Wow, that looks amazing!"), asked how it was performing on that big stage, congratulated Calvin on the tour wrap-up ("Congrats on achieving such an awesome moment!"), and is looking forward to seeing the music video Calvin started shooting for his new album the weekend before (~2023-08-25/26) — the shoot is in Miami, on an awesome beach (he loves the Miami beaches) — and offered to help with props for the video; the chat ended with an exchange about Calvin's custom octopus guitar — Dave called it "a representation of your journey, your passion for music, and the friendships you've made", marveled at its "gorgeous purple hue" (a custom shiny finish Calvin chose because it goes with his style), and said Calvin's unique style really stands out in his music and playing, then affirmed that staying true to yourself and your style is vital and makes Calvin unique and his music stand out ("Keep it real, bud. You've got something great to give the world."), re-sharing a garage photo of a man working on a car engine (Calvin's side in the Octopus guitar section of /memories/calvin.md); as of 2023-08-22, reconnected with Calvin: shared his card night with friends on 2023-08-18 ("so much fun"; photo of men around a table with playing cards) and congratulated Calvin on scoring a deal to continue collaborating with Frank Ocean, and later on 2023-08-22 asked about other collaborations and upcoming concerts, agreed to meet up when Calvin's tour ends and he heads to Boston, and looked forward to the podcast Calvin recorded with friends on 2023-08-21 about the rap industry, and on 2023-08-14, attended a car workshop in San Francisco (dove into car restoration and the different techniques; people there "really passionate and dedicated" — "truly inspiring"), and updated Calvin that his car restoration is "going great" (photo of the car — a car with a broken engine in the woods — going "from a beat-up mess to a real beauty"; hopes to have it all fixed up by the end of September 2023), and the chat closed with Calvin cheering him on ("You got this, Dave!"); as of 2023-08-11, was picked for a car mod workshop (a dream come true — he's always wanted to learn auto engineering and work on building a custom car); on his current car he's doing engine swaps and suspension modifications and is learning body mods, giving a classic muscle car a "modern twist" (photo of a silver Corvette); in the same chat he said the goal was "a modern vibe but also that classic muscle car style" — the small details make it "unique and personalized", "like customizing a work of art on wheels" — and he's "really happy with it"; he also has a music studio setup with a high-quality sound system and offered Calvin a hand with his music (Calvin: busy but will keep it in mind); as of 2023-08-03, told Calvin fixing cars is like therapy for him: growing up working on cars with his dad, refurbishing them gives a sense of fulfillment; fond childhood memories — one summer he and his dad restored an old car together ("knowing that we did it together was really satisfying"), shared a photo from that time (a man and a child posing); on 2023-07-21, just back from a road trip with friends through stunning countryside (a break from the "corporate mayhem"; winding roads, views and chatting "recharged" him and reminded him why he loves cars; shared a photo of a person riding a motorcycle down a dirt road — "a wonderful place" they found; says reconnecting with his passion makes the long hours at work worth it), and in his 2023-07-21 chat with Calvin encouraged him to keep collaborating and staying surrounded by good vibes, telling him "keep going, buddy!" and calling himself Calvin's "biggest fan"; on 2023-07-07 has arranged regular walks with friends at a favorite park spot: a city skyline with a river and boats (photo shared, "today we are going to that spot"), and confirmed Calvin's car is fixed after the crash; on 2023-06-21: sympathized with Calvin's car accident (2023-06-16) and asked about the insurance process and the mechanic; earlier (2023-06-09): explores parks on weekends to relax ("so peaceful being surrounded by nature"; weekend walks "recharge [him] for the entire upcoming week"); calls Boston parks "awesome, especially in spring" (walked one 2023-06-02); hasn't hiked recently but finds hiking "clears your mind and brings a sense of calm"; booked a trip to a mountainous region for July 2023 ("finally gonna be able to see those majestic peaks") and promised Calvin lots of pics when he gets back; car maintenance shop (opened ~2023-05-08/14, teaming up with a local garage), recently fixed a neighbor's car engine himself; working on cars "definitely therapeutic", fixing things gives purpose, "like giving it a second chance"; obsessed with classic cars (restored one in 2022), dreams of building a custom car from scratch; music lover (favorite band Aerosmith; creative-block tip: immerse in concerts and favorite albums); apparently based in Boston, plans to show Calvin around and will be at Calvin's Boston show; after seeing Calvin's Tokyo skyline photo wants to visit Tokyo himself. On 2023-06-21 also cheered Calvin on trusting the repair shop, marveled at Calvin's photo of a small town in Japan with mountains, and asked whether Calvin has tried skiing; also announced he recently joined a rock band and is practicing guitar (shared a photo of the band), and he says good company and great music lift the mood and bring positive emotions. As of 2023-07-07, has never been to Japan but is "so keen to go one day" (heard it's full of vibes, good eats and awesome tech) and is "hooked on" Japanese music. Also on 2023-08-03, asked Calvin about his biggest goal, encouraged him to "keep it up and keep making a difference", and closed by urging him to "keep at it and never forget your dreams" and "You've got this!". /memories/dave.md:L79: - On 2023-10-23, told Calvin (who asked "what made you start working on cars?") that his car passion started when he was ten: he'd been fascinated with how machines work, found an old car in a neighbor's garage, and asked if he could fix it — "that's when my love for car engineering began!" — he enjoyed transforming it from broken-down to high-running, and that sense of accomplishment made him hooked, so he's been working on cars ever since (shared a photo of a man working on a car in a garage; comes with his remark that working on a car is his outlet — "a little oasis of calm" — where he's "connecting back with myself" — see the 2023-10-23 entry of ## Relationships; complements the childhood memories of tinkering with engines in his dad's garage recorded above; Calvin: "Impressive! That must have taken a lot of skill and determination to bring that car back to life.", and asked whether it was a classic car and whether Dave still has it or is working on another project — Dave answered in the continuation of the same day's chat, which is not in this excerpt: he restored a car last year (2022, the 2022 restoration, see above) but sold it to a collector, and is now working on a new car project he finds quite a challenge [S25T14][S25T15][S25T16][S25T17].
/memories/dave.md:L80: - On 2023-10-23, told Calvin (who asked what the toughest part of car restoration is) that it takes a lot of patience but the payoff is worth it, and paying extra attention to detail isn't easy but it pays off — echoing his earlier remarks that small details make his mod project unique and personalized (details in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)) and that the small successes make him proud (see above) [S25T18][S25T19].
/memories/dave.md:L112: - On 2023-10-23, while praising the attention to detail in Calvin's music ("Loving the attention to detail in your work, it makes it extra special. /memories/dave.md:L183: - On 2023-10-23, caught up with Calvin, picking back up a chat they'd had "the other day" about fame and its impact on relationships (a chat not otherwise recorded in this memory): asked how the tour with Frank Ocean is going — "It must be awesome but it must have its own struggles too" — and how Calvin juggles his job plus his personal life; Calvin: the tour's been incredible — performing and connecting with the crowd energizes him — but fame has its own challenges and balancing everything is tough [S25T1][S25T2]. Dave asked how he manages and whether he ever feels overwhelmed; Calvin: he takes it one day at a time, but it can get overwhelming with so many demands — still, he enjoys what he does so he pushes on [S25T3][S25T4]. Dave asked for strategies that help Calvin manage everything; Calvin: having a strong support system is really helpful — his friends and team keep him on track — and Dave agreed that having people who understand and support you is really important [S25T5][S25T6]. Dave then told Calvin he recently had a good conversation with some neighbors about current events and politics — it was nice to hear different perspectives and share their own — and that interacting like that cheers him up and helps him stay informed, and asked Calvin how he stays informed; Calvin: staying connected and up-to-date on world events is important to him — it helps his music stand out by incorporating unique perspectives, connects him better with his fans, and keeps him motivated and inspired (Calvin's side in the 2023-10-23 entry of the Relationships section of /memories/calvin.md) [S25T7][S25T8]. The conversation then turned to art: Dave said "Art is amazing how it reflects the world" and asked whether anything had caught Calvin's eye lately and made an impact on his music; Calvin: yes — recently he's been really inspired by the struggles that people go through, and it's made him dig deeper into his music to try to capture those feelings [S25T9][S25T10]. Dave asked whether using his music to share experiences and feelings is cathartic for him; Calvin: it's a way for him to express himself and work through his emotions — "like my own form of therapy" (Calvin's details in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md) [S25T11][S25T12]. Dave said he gets it — cars give him an outlet to express himself, "like a little oasis of calm," and working on one is "like I'm connecting back with myself" — and that the music helps too; he shared a photo of his garage (a garage with a bunch of tools hanging on the wall — "a little dirty, but everything is in its place"; details in ## Car maintenance shop) [S25T13]. Calvin: "Looking cool — what made you start working on cars?"; Dave: ever since he was ten he's been fascinated with how machines work — he found an old car in a neighbor's garage, asked if he could fix it, and that's when his love for car engineering began — he enjoyed transforming it from broken-down to high-running, and that sense of accomplishment made him hooked, so he's been working on cars ever since (shared a photo of a man working on a car in a garage; details in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose) [S25T14][S25T15]. Calvin: "Impressive! That must have taken a lot of skill and determination to bring that car back to life." and asked whether it was a classic car and whether Dave still has it or is currently working on another project [S25T16]; Dave answered in the continuation of the chat: "Thanks Calvin! It was a fun project. I restored a car last year, but I sold it to a collector" (the 2022 restoration — see ## Classic cars), "Now I'm working on something new, and it's quite a challenge!" — sharing a photo of his new project car (a black car parked in a parking lot — "Take a look at this wonderful car!") [S25T17]. Calvin: "Cool! Been wanting to try that. What would you say is the toughest part of car restoration?" — Dave: it takes a lot of patience but the payoff is worth it, and paying extra attention to detail isn't easy but it pays off [S25T18][S25T19]. Calvin: details "can really make a difference" and are what makes something great — "like a well-crafted rap song or a sleek and stylish car" [S25T20]; Dave: paying attention to details "makes a big difference, whether it's in music or with vehicles" — little things can make a big impact [S25T21]. Calvin: without those details it's just average, and as an artist he wants to create something extraordinary — sharing a photo of his record (a silver disc in a black frame on a table; Calvin's side in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md) [S25T22]; Dave: he loves the attention to detail in Calvin's work — "it makes it extra special. Keep on creating!" — sharing a photo of his brown amp (a brown amp with a black knob and a brown cover; Dave's side in the Music section of /memories/dave.md) [S25T23]; Calvin: "Thanks Dave! Appreciate your support!" [S25T24].
